sketch.name: CarbonCreditTracker
sketch.description: A RIN and low-carbon-fuel credit widget: D6 and D4 RIN, California LCFS, Oregon CFP and Washington CFS prices with their change and trend, the credits held and their value, and what each adds to a gallon of ethanol.
sketch.html: CreditPrice30-day trendHeldValue¢/gal

props.name: selected
props.description: Id of the selected credit; the uplift per gallon adds it to the D6 RIN.

props.name: rvo
props.description: The renewable volume obligation in RINs, for the RVO coverage total; 0 hides it.

props.name: credits
props.description: Credits: { id, name, program (RFS, LCFS, CFP, CFS), price, unit (¢ or $), change, held (credits), perGallon (¢ a gallon of ethanol earns), history (oldest first) }.

sketch.notes: Simple control (no designer-edited items): credits are data rows. RINs priced in cents per RIN, state credits in dollars per tonne CO2e; holdings value converts cents to dollars. Uplift per gallon = the D6 RIN's ¢/gal plus the selected state program's (a gallon earns one D6 RIN and, in a low-carbon market, the credits its CI generates). RVO coverage = D6 RINs held / rvo. Program chips: RFS violet, LCFS sky, CFP green, CFS amber; trends green up / red down. Sparklines as small SVGs; rows as native widgets. Meant for a GridBoard card about 7 columns x 5 rows.
